reason: The S0-to-S1 changes only move existing loop-variable declarations into their respective for initializers. They do not change any entry point, API protocol, persistent state, configuration, input semantics, attack surface, loop bounds, or called operations. H0 therefore needs no adaptation to exercise behavior affected by this commit.
evidence: In adler32-standalone.c main, `int i; for (i = 0; i < num_reps; i++)` becomes `for (int i = 0; i < num_reps; i++)`; `calculate_hash(g_buffer, BUFFER_SIZE)` and the bounds remain unchanged.
In bench-c-deflate-fragmentation.c decode, only the declaration scope of `i` changes; the loop still runs `i < reps` and calls `decode_once(frag_dst, frag_idat)`.
In bench-c-deflate-fragmentation.c main, only the declaration scope of `i` changes; the five iterations and all four `decode` calls remain unchanged.
In print-json-token-debug-format.c main1, only the declaration scope of `i` changes; the loop still traverses `quirks` until zero and calls `wuffs_base__token_decoder__set_quirk_enabled` identically.
H0 already exercises GIF and JSON decoding through `fuzz`, but the commit introduces no changed decoding behavior or new control dimension for those harnesses to cover.
recommended_action: No fuzz-harness maintenance is needed for this commit.
